tvShow.name: Black Doves
tvShow.overview: When a spy posing as a politician's wife learns her lover has been murdered, an old assassin friend joins her on a quest for truth — and vengeance.

episodes.name: To Love Then
episodes.overview: When politician's wife and undercover spy Helen Webb learns that her lover has been murdered, the Black Doves recruit an old friend to help protect her.

episodes.name: A Little Black Dove
episodes.overview: After reaching a dead end in the search for Jason's killer, Helen has to fight for her own life, while Sam receives a threat from his former employer.

episodes.name: The Coming Night
episodes.overview: Memories of Sam's past come back to haunt him as he prepares to finish the job he started seven years ago. Wallace secretly meets with a Chinese envoy.

episodes.name: Go Bang Time
episodes.overview: Investigations into the ambassador's death reach the highest corridors of power. Helen pays a risky visit to an old friend, and Sam faces a tough choice.

episodes.name: The Cost of It All
episodes.overview: With danger drawing closer, Sam takes refuge in the only safe place he knows. Reed issues an ultimatum, and Helen gets one step closer to the truth.

episodes.name: In the Bleak Midwinter
episodes.overview: Armed with evidence and bent on vengeance, Helen goes searching for the Clarks. As the conspiracy starts to unravel, she has a deadly decision to make.

videos.name: Ben Whishaw & Keira Knightley look back on tight stunts and chilling in cars for Black Doves | BAFTA
